entities.description: Procedure for activating dedicated EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message

relations.description: When TAI change occurs with current TAI not in TAI list, the ESM procedure is aborted.
After aborting ESM procedure due to TAI change not in list, tracking area updating procedure must be performed successfully.
When TAI change occurs but current TAI remains in TAI list, UE implementation decides how to re-initiate ESM procedure.
When no TAI change occurs, UE implementation decides how to re-initiate ESM procedure.
ESM uplink message transmission failure case does not apply to ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message.
Transmission failure of ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT affects how dedicated EPS bearer activation is re-initiated.
Dedicated EPS bearer activation procedure may use ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message for re-initiation.
Dedicated EPS bearer activation procedure may use ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message for re-initiation.
